name: Admin and security
description: Custom attributes, API keys, webhooks, RBAC and SSO.
takeaways: Custom attributes copy once, at creation

cards.title: What they are
cards.body: Fields you add to customers, contracts or products. Name and key are unique across the organization. The key and type cannot change, and an attribute cannot be deleted.

cards.title: Types
cards.body: Text, Whole number, Decimal number, Checkbox, Dropdown, Multi-select, Array.

cards.title: Scope and required
cards.body: One business entity (customer and contract attributes) or all entities (also product attributes). Required means a value on every record: default is written if blank, and without a default saving fails.
cards.example: Required Sales region with default EMEA.

cards.title: Copied values
cards.body: A customer attribute copies to new contracts and invoices; a contract attribute to its invoices; product attributes never copy. Copy happens once at creation and later changes do not flow.
cards.example: Acme APAC, then Americas: Contract_1 keeps APAC, Contract_2 gets Americas.

cards.title: Where they are used
cards.body: Billable metric SQL variables (customer, contract, product) and document or email templates.

cards.title: Business entity
cards.body: The legal or billing unit that issues invoices, with its own tax configuration, served countries and optionally scoped custom attributes.

cards.title: RBAC
cards.body: Permissions are grouped into roles; roles are assigned to users, who can also get extra permissions.

cards.title: SAML SSO and 2FA
cards.body: SAML works with Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace and Okta, with domain verification. Two-factor authentication is available for users.

cards.title: Communications
cards.body: Email templates and alerts, document templates, senders and sent emails, with template variables for invoices, credit notes, receipts and usage reports.

cards.title: API keys
cards.body: Sent in the x-api-key header. Prefixed sandbox_ or production_. Shown once; Zenskar stores only a hash. No expiry and no scoping: a key inherits the organization's permissions.

cards.title: Calling the API
cards.body: Lists use next or previous cursors with a limit. Two OpenAPI specs exist (20240301 and 20260301). Usage events go to api.zenskar.com/usage/{api_slug}.
cards.example: Page through customers with a cursor.

cards.title: Webhooks
cards.body: Zenskar POSTs events (customer, payment, usage ingestion) to an HTTPS endpoint, signed with X-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body). Up to 3 attempts, 30 second timeout, 4xx not retried.

cards.title: Handling deliveries
cards.body: Delivery is at-least-once and unordered. Deduplicate on event_id and apply events by occurred_at per object_id.
cards.example: Skip an event older than the last applied one.

edgeCases: Required without default. Saving a record without a value fails.
Copied values. Once, at creation. Source changes do not propagate and copy changes do not flow back.
Option removed. Records keep a dropdown option that was later removed.
Scope change. Changing scope or required status does not change saved values.
Lost API key. It cannot be recovered. Delete it and create a new one.
Signatures. Hash the raw body bytes; re-serializing JSON breaks the match.
Webhook URLs. Must be HTTPS and not point at private or internal hosts.
Key stability. The custom attribute key and type are permanent; only the name can change.

api.note: Auth: x-api-key: sandbox_... or production_.... Webhook signature: sha256= plus HMAC-SHA256 of the exact body bytes with the webhook secret.

quiz.question: Which header carries the API key?
quiz.explanation: Keys are prefixed sandbox_ or production_.

quiz.question: You lost an API key. What now?
options: Create a new key; the old one cannot be recovered

quiz.question: Acme's Sales region changes to Americas after Contract_1 exists. Contract_1 shows…
quiz.explanation: Copied values do not change when the source changes.

quiz.question: Can a custom attribute be deleted?
quiz.explanation: Attributes cannot be deleted and their key and type are permanent.

quiz.question: How should a webhook handler cope with duplicates and reordering?
options: Deduplicate on event_id and apply by occurred_at

qa.question: Custom attribute vs tag?
qa.answer: Custom attributes are defined fields; tagging is a separate field also called custom_attributes on some objects.

qa.question: Display name vs key name?
qa.answer: The display name is shown in the product. The key name is the permanent API identifier.

qa.question: Customer attribute vs contract vs product attribute?
qa.answer: Customer values copy to new contracts and invoices; contract values to invoices; product values never copy.

qa.question: Entity-scoped vs global attribute?
qa.answer: Scoped to one business entity or all entities. Product attributes are always global.

qa.question: API key vs webhook secret?
qa.answer: The key authenticates your calls to Zenskar. The secret verifies Zenskar's calls to you.

qa.question: Role vs permission?
qa.answer: Permissions are grouped into roles assigned to users.

qa.question: SAML SSO vs two-factor?
qa.answer: SSO delegates login to your identity provider; two-factor adds a second step.

qa.question: Sandbox vs production key?
qa.answer: Prefixed sandbox_ or production_ and used against the matching environment.

qa.question: Track sales region on customers?
qa.answer: A customer dropdown attribute.

qa.question: Use an attribute in a billable metric?
qa.answer: Reference its key in the SQL variables.

qa.question: Notify your CRM on payment?
qa.answer: Subscribe a webhook to payment events.

qa.question: Limit someone to read-only?
qa.answer: Give a role with read permissions only.

qa.question: Sign in with Okta?
qa.answer: Configure SAML with domain verification.

qa.question: Can a custom attribute be deleted?
qa.answer: The dashboard has no delete and keys and types are permanent. A soft delete exists at API level behind a separate permission.

qa.question: Customer region changed later?
qa.answer: Copied values do not change on existing contracts.

qa.question: Lost an API key?
qa.answer: It cannot be recovered; create a new one.

qa.question: Webhook duplicates or reordering?
qa.answer: Deduplicate on event_id and apply by occurred_at.

qa.question: Signature mismatch?
qa.answer: Hash the raw body bytes, not re-serialized JSON.

qa.question: Required attribute without a default?
qa.answer: Saving fails if blank.

qa.question: Webhook endpoint rules?
qa.answer: HTTPS only; 3 attempts, 30 second timeout, 4xx not retried.

qa.question: How do I call the API?
qa.answer: Send x-api-key and organisation headers to api.zenskar.com.

qa.question: What are the webhook event categories?
qa.answer: Customer, payment and usage event ingestion.
